vcu_g_0159_20000009.name: dma_tx_queue_wr_idx
vcu_g_0159_20000009.description: Write (producer) index of the 8-slot DMA1 channel 7 transmit queue whose header starts at 0x20000008. FUN_08008bb0 writes a record at this index and advances it (wraps at 8). The queue is non-empty while it differs from the read index at 0x20000008 (a family of another packet), and vcu_dma_tx_queue_service consumes records from there.

vcu_g_0159_2000000a.name: dma_tx_queue_credits
vcu_g_0159_2000000a.description: Free record slots of the transmit queue at 0x20000008 (probably initialised to 8). FUN_08008bb0 decrements it for each enqueued record and refuses records at 0. vcu_dma_tx_queue_service increments it after each transmit that it starts successfully.

vcu_g_0159_2000000b.name: dma_tx_enqueue_busy
vcu_g_0159_2000000b.description: Re-entrancy guard of the transmit-queue enqueue function FUN_08008bb0: set to 1 while a record is being written. vcu_dma_tx_queue_service does nothing while it is set.

vcu_g_0159_2000000c.name: dma_tx_service_busy
vcu_g_0159_2000000c.description: Re-entrancy guard of vcu_dma_tx_queue_service (FUN_08005704): set to 1 while it starts the next queued transmit and cleared afterwards. FUN_08008bb0 refuses to enqueue while it is set.

vcu_g_0159_20000010.name: dma_tx_records
vcu_g_0159_20000010.description: Eight 256-byte records of the DMA1 channel 7 transmit queue; record i starts at 0x20000010 + 0x100*i. Each has a 32-bit length word (only the low 16 bits are read by the DMA start) and a payload of up to 242 bytes accepted by the enqueue. vcu_dma_tx_queue_service passes the payload (0x20000014 + 0x100*i) and its length to vcu_dma_tx_start.

vcu_g_0159_200018a4.name: dma1_ch7_started
vcu_g_0159_200018a4.description: Set to 1 by vcu_dma_tx_start each time it starts a DMA1 channel 7 transfer (memory address written to DMA1 channel 7 at 0x4002008c, count through FUN_0800c848). Together with the channel's transfer-complete flag (FUN_0800c884 on 0x02000000) it decides whether the channel is still busy. Who clears it is not in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_200018b8.name: dma_rx_read_pos
vcu_g_0159_200018b8.description: Read position (0..249) in the 250-byte receive ring at 0x20002eb4 for RX channel 0; vcu_dma_ring_drain indexes it as [channel] with stride 2, and only channel 0 is used in VCU_0159. It is advanced by one for each byte copied, wraps to 0 after 249, and catches up to the DMA write position computed from the count register at 0x4002006c that the caller passes in.
